facts.sentence: The death benefit during any policy year is the amount listed for that year in Exhibit A.

facts.name: No Daily Decrease in Death Benefit
facts.sentence: The death benefit does not decrease on a daily basis.

facts.name: Annual Death Benefit Application
facts.sentence: The full year’s death benefit applies from policy anniversary to policy anniversary.

facts.name: Minimum Death Benefit Floor

facts.name: Primary Beneficiary Designation
facts.sentence: The primary beneficiary is Lakeshore Federal Credit Union.

facts.name: Collateral Assignee Designation
facts.sentence: Lakeshore Federal Credit Union is designated as the collateral assignee.

facts.name: Loan Balance Priority
facts.sentence: Lakeshore Federal Credit Union receives proceeds only up to the outstanding loan balance.

facts.name: Spousal Proceeds Entitlement
facts.sentence: Roberto Javier Fernandez, spouse of the insured, is entitled to the remaining proceeds as primary beneficiary.

facts.name: Remaining Proceeds Allocation
facts.sentence: Roberto Javier Fernandez holds a 100% share of the remaining proceeds.

facts.name: Contingent Beneficiary Designation
facts.sentence: The contingent beneficiary is the estate of the insured.

facts.name: Definition of Death Benefit
facts.sentence: ‘Death Benefit’ means the decreasing face amount payable upon the insured’s death as specified in Section 3.

facts.name: Collateral Assignment Definition
facts.sentence: ‘Collateral Assignment’ means the assignment of policy proceeds to a lending institution as security for a loan.

facts.name: Collateral Assignment Limit
facts.sentence: A ‘Collateral Assignment’ is limited to the outstanding loan balance.

facts.name: Grace Period Duration
facts.sentence: The grace period is a 31-day period following a missed premium due date.

facts.name: Grace Period Coverage
facts.sentence: Coverage remains active during the grace period.

facts.name: Grace Period Definition
facts.sentence: A Grace Period means a 31-day period following a missed premium due date.

facts.name: Grace Period Coverage Continuity
facts.sentence: Coverage continues during the Grace Period.

facts.name: Policy Anniversary Date
facts.sentence: A Policy Anniversary means each May 20 following the issue date.

facts.name: Death Benefit Eligibility
facts.sentence: We will pay the death benefit if the insured dies while this policy is in force.

facts.name: Death Before Expiry Condition
facts.sentence: We will pay the death benefit if death occurs before the policy expiry date.

facts.name: Death Benefit Eligibility Condition
facts.sentence: We will pay the death benefit if satisfactory proof of death is received by us.

facts.name: Loan Balance Payment to Assignee
facts.sentence: If a collateral assignment is in effect, we will pay the outstanding balance of the assigned loan directly to the assignee.

facts.name: Remaining Benefit to Beneficiary
facts.sentence: If a collateral assignment is in effect, any remaining death benefit will be paid to the named beneficiary.

facts.name: Death Benefit Cap Limitation
facts.sentence: We will not pay an amount exceeding the death benefit in force on the date of death.

facts.name: Death Benefit Cap Clause
facts.sentence: We will not pay more than the death benefit in force on the date of death, regardless of the original loan amount.

facts.name: Lump Sum Payout Timing
facts.sentence: The death benefit is paid in a lump sum within 30 days of claim approval.

facts.name: Monthly Premium Amount
facts.sentence: The level monthly premium is $38.00.

facts.name: Monthly Premium Due Date
facts.sentence: The level monthly premium of $38.00 is due on the 20th of each month throughout the policy term.

facts.name: Grace Period After Missed Payment
facts.sentence: A grace period of 31 days follows each missed premium due date.

facts.name: Premium Non-Payment Leads to Lapse
facts.sentence: If the premium remains unpaid after the grace period, the policy lapses.

facts.name: Premium Default Consequence
facts.sentence: If the premium remains unpaid after the grace period, all coverage ceases.

facts.name: Reinstatement Window After Lapse
facts.sentence: Reinstatement is available within 3 years of lapse.

facts.name: Reinstatement Requirement
facts.sentence: Reinstatement is subject to evidence of insurability.

facts.name: Reinstatement Premium Requirement
facts.sentence: Reinstatement requires payment of all overdue premiums.

facts.name: Reinstatement Interest Requirement
facts.sentence: Reinstatement requires payment of 6% interest per annum on overdue premiums.

facts.name: Assignee Rights Limited to Loan Balance
facts.sentence: A collateral assignment attached at issue or thereafter grants the assignee the right to receive proceeds up to the outstanding balance of the secured loan.

facts.name: Assignee Beneficiary Rights Limitation
facts.sentence: The collateral assignee has no right to change the beneficiary designation.

facts.name: Assignee Cannot Surrender Policy
facts.sentence: The collateral assignee has no right to surrender this policy.

facts.name: Assignee Cannot Cancel Policy
facts.sentence: The collateral assignee has no right to cancel this policy.

facts.name: Assignee Loan Repayment Right
facts.sentence: The assignee has the right to receive proceeds up to the outstanding balance of the secured loan.

facts.name: Assignee Beneficiary Rights Limitation
facts.sentence: The collateral assignee has no right to change the beneficiary designation.

facts.name: Assignee Cannot Surrender Policy
facts.sentence: The collateral assignee has no right to surrender this policy.

facts.name: Assignee Cannot Cancel Policy
facts.sentence: The collateral assignee has no right to cancel this policy.

facts.name: Assignee Payment Limitation
facts.sentence: The collateral assignee cannot receive more than the outstanding loan balance.

facts.name: Owner Release Right
facts.sentence: The owner may request release of the collateral assignment at any time.

facts.name: Owner Release Procedure
facts.sentence: The owner must submit a release form signed by the assignee to request release of the collateral assignment.

facts.name: No Liability Until Notice Received
facts.sentence: HomeGuard Life will not be liable for any act taken in reliance on a collateral assignment notice.

facts.name: Liability Trigger Condition
facts.sentence: HomeGuard Life will not be liable until the collateral assignment notice is received at its home office in writing.

facts.name: Suicide Clause Liability Limit
facts.sentence: If the insured dies by suicide within two years of the issue date, HomeGuard Life’s liability is limited to a refund of premiums paid.

facts.name: Suicide Clause Coverage Scope
facts.sentence: Suicide includes both sane and insane states of mind under the suicide clause.

facts.name: Suicide Clause Limitation
facts.sentence: Any collateral assignee will receive only the lesser of their outstanding loan balance or the refunded premiums if the insured dies by suicide within two years of the issue date.

facts.name: Only Suicide Clause Exclusion
facts.sentence: No other exclusions apply to this policy besides the suicide clause.

facts.name: Conversion Privilege Eligibility
facts.sentence: The owner may convert the then-current death benefit to a permanent life insurance policy offered by HomeGuard Life.

facts.name: No Evidence of Insurability Required
facts.sentence: Conversion requires no evidence of insurability.

facts.name: Conversion Deadline
facts.sentence: Conversion must be requested before the 20th anniversary of the policy.

facts.name: Conversion Age Limit
facts.sentence: The insured must not have yet reached age 65 at the time of conversion request.

facts.name: Assignee Consent for Conversion
facts.sentence: Any collateral assignee must provide written consent for conversion to proceed.

facts.name: Converted Policy Face Amount Rule
facts.sentence: The converted policy face amount equals the decreasing benefit amount in force at the time of conversion.

facts.name: Complete Claim Form HG-CLM-01
facts.sentence: To file a death claim, the claimant must complete Form HG-CLM-01.

facts.name: Death Claim Documentation Requirement
facts.sentence: To file a death claim, the claimant must submit a certified copy of the death certificate.

facts.name: Death Claim Documentation Requirement
facts.sentence: To file a death claim, the claimant must provide either the original policy or a lost-policy affidavit.

facts.name: Lender Payoff Statement Requirement
facts.sentence: If the policy is collateral assigned, the claimant must provide a lender's payoff statement dated within 30 days of death.

facts.name: Claim Submission Address
facts.sentence: All claim documents must be sent to HomeGuard Life Assurance Company, Claims Processing Center.

facts.name: Insurer Identification
facts.sentence: HomeGuard Life Assurance Company is the insurer issuing the policy.

facts.name: Policy Issue Date
facts.sentence: The policy was issued on May 20, 2024.

facts.name: Collateral Payoff Requirement
facts.sentence: If collateral is assigned under the policy, a lender's payoff statement must be provided.

facts.name: Payoff Statement Timeliness
facts.sentence: The lender's payoff statement must be dated within 30 days of the insured’s death.

facts.name: Claim Document Submission Location
facts.sentence: All claim-related documents must be sent to HomeGuard Life Assurance Company.

facts.name: Claim Submission Address
facts.sentence: Documents should be sent to the Claims Processing Center of HomeGuard Life Assurance Company.

facts.name: Claim Submission Address
facts.sentence: The mailing address for submissions is P.O. Box 7700, Milwaukee, WI 53201.

facts.name: Claim Payment Timeline
facts.sentence: HomeGuard Life Assurance Company will pay valid claims within 30 days of receiving all required documentation.

facts.name: Incontestability Clause
facts.sentence: After two years from the issue date, HomeGuard Life Assurance Company may not contest the policy during the insured's lifetime.

facts.name: Non-Payment Exception
facts.sentence: The exception to the incontestability clause is non-payment of premium.

facts.name: Misstatement of Age/Sex Adjustment
facts.sentence: If there is a misstatement of age or sex, benefits will be adjusted to reflect the amount that could have been purchased at the correct age and sex.

facts.name: Entire Contract Clause
facts.sentence: This policy, along with the application form and Exhibit A (Decreasing Benefit Schedule), constitutes the entire contractual agreement between the parties.

facts.name: Governing Law Jurisdiction
facts.sentence: The governing law for this policy is the State of Wisconsin.

facts.name: Policy Issuance Date

facts.name: 15-Year Level Term with Rider
facts.sentence: The policy type is 15-Year Level Term with Accelerated Benefit Rider.

facts.name: Living Benefits Series Policy
facts.sentence: The policy belongs to the Living Benefits Series.

facts.name: Owner and Insured Identity
facts.sentence: Naomi Elise Okafor is both the Policy Owner and the Insured Person.

facts.name: Date of Birth Confirmation
facts.sentence: Naomi Elise Okafor's Date of Birth is October 12, 1986.

facts.name: Preferred Plus Non-Tobacco Classification
facts.sentence: Naomi Elise Okafor is classified under Risk Class Preferred Plus Non-Tobacco.

facts.name: Level Death Benefit
facts.sentence: The Total Death Benefit of the policy is $600,000 and remains level throughout coverage.

facts.name: Base Coverage Terms
facts.sentence: Layer 1 of the death benefit is $300,000 and covers a 15-year term that expires on June 2039.

facts.name: Accelerated Benefit Rider Terms
facts.sentence: Layer 2 of the death benefit is $300,000 and covers a 10-year term that expires on June 2034.

facts.name: Base Premium Amount
facts.sentence: The base premium for Layer 1 is $39.00 per month.

facts.name: Rider Premium Amount
facts.sentence: The rider premium for Layer 2 is $22.00 per month.

facts.name: Combined Monthly Premium
facts.sentence: The combined monthly premium amount is $61.00.

facts.name: Automatic Premium Deduction
facts.sentence: The total monthly premium is automatically deducted from the policyholder’s account.

facts.name: Primary Beneficiary Designation
facts.sentence: Kwame Jabari Okafor is designated as the Primary Beneficiary.

facts.name: Marital Relationship Confirmation
facts.sentence: Kwame Jabari Okafor is married to Naomi Elise Okafor.

facts.name: Primary Beneficiary Allocation
facts.sentence: Kwame Jabari Okafor receives 100% of the primary beneficiary share.

facts.name: Contingent Beneficiary Designation
facts.sentence: Okafor-Williams Family Trust is designated as the Contingent Beneficiary.

facts.name: Okafor-Williams Trust Formation
facts.sentence: The Okafor-Williams Family Trust was established on May 1, 2024.

facts.name: Contingent Beneficiary Distribution
facts.sentence: The Okafor-Williams Family Trust receives 100% of the contingent beneficiary share.

facts.name: Contingent Beneficiary Designation
facts.sentence: The contingent beneficiary is the Okafor-Williams Family Trust.

facts.name: Trust Establishment Date
facts.sentence: The Okafor-Williams Family Trust was established on May 1, 2024.

facts.name: Contingent Beneficiary Ownership
facts.sentence: The Okafor-Williams Family Trust holds a 100% ownership interest in the contingent beneficiary designation.

facts.name: Base Policy Death Benefit
facts.sentence: The 'Base Policy Death Benefit' refers to the $300,000 payable under Layer 1 of the policy upon the insured's death.

facts.name: Base Death Benefit – Layer 1
facts.sentence: Layer 1 of the policy provides a base death benefit of $300,000.

facts.name: Layer 2 Rider Coverage
facts.sentence: The 'Layer 2 Rider' refers to an additional $300,000 term coverage.

facts.name: Layer 2 Rider Expiration
facts.sentence: The Layer 2 Rider expires on the 10th policy anniversary.

facts.name: Qualifying Terminal Condition Definition
facts.sentence: A 'Qualifying Terminal Condition' is defined as a medical condition certified by a licensed physician.

facts.name: Terminal Condition Definition
facts.sentence: A Qualifying Terminal Condition is expected to result in the insured's death within 24 months.

facts.name: Qualifying Chronic Condition Definition
facts.sentence: A 'Qualifying Chronic Condition' is defined as the permanent inability to perform at least two of six Activities of Daily Living (ADLs).

facts.name: Chronic Condition Certification Requirement
facts.sentence: A Qualifying Chronic Condition must be certified by a licensed healthcare practitioner.

facts.name: Permanent Chronic Condition
facts.sentence: A Qualifying Chronic Condition is expected to be permanent.

facts.name: Accelerated Benefit Definition
facts.sentence: An 'Accelerated Benefit' refers to the advance of a portion of the death benefit during the insured's lifetime.

facts.name: Accelerated Benefit Eligibility Criteria
facts.sentence: An Accelerated Benefit can be claimed when the insured meets criteria for either a Qualifying Terminal Condition or a Qualifying Chronic Condition.

facts.name: Reduced Death Benefit Definition
facts.sentence: A 'Reduced Death Benefit' is the remaining death benefit after payment of an accelerated benefit.

facts.name: Reduced Death Benefit Calculation
facts.sentence: The Reduced Death Benefit equals the original benefit minus any accelerated amount plus a discount adjustment.

facts.name: Grace Period Duration
facts.sentence: The 'Grace Period' is a 31-day window after each monthly premium due date.

facts.name: Grace Period Coverage Continuity
facts.sentence: Coverage remains active during the Grace Period.

facts.name: Death Benefit Payout Condition
facts.sentence: The total death benefit will be paid to the named beneficiary upon the insured's death while the policy is in force.

facts.name: Death Benefit Reduction Rule
facts.sentence: Any reduction in the death benefit is subject to prior accelerated benefit payments.

facts.name: Post-Rider Death Benefit Amount
facts.sentence: After the Layer 2 Rider expires on the 10th policy anniversary, the total death benefit available is $300,000.

facts.name: Layer 2 Expiration Effect
facts.sentence: When the Layer 2 Rider expires, only Layer 1 remains effective.

facts.name: Lump Sum Payment
facts.sentence: The death benefit is paid in a lump sum.

facts.name: Death Benefit Payout Timeline
facts.sentence: The death benefit is paid within 30 days of claim approval.

facts.name: Accelerated Benefit Payment Timeline
facts.sentence: The accelerated death benefit is paid in a lump sum within 30 days of claim approval.

facts.name: Terminal Condition Acceleration Eligibility
facts.sentence: A terminal condition acceleration is available if the insured is diagnosed with a Qualifying Terminal Condition.

facts.name: Terminal Condition Acceleration Limit
facts.sentence: Up to 80% of the then-current total death benefit may be accelerated under the terminal condition provision.

facts.name: Terminal Benefit Cap
facts.sentence: The maximum amount that can be accelerated per claim under the terminal condition provision is $400,000.

facts.name: One-Time Terminal Acceleration
facts.sentence: Only one terminal condition acceleration is permitted per policy lifetime.

facts.name: Discount for Terminal Acceleration
facts.sentence: A discount factor reflecting the time value of money is applied to terminal condition accelerations.

facts.name: Discounted Terminal Benefit Payment
facts.sentence: The insured receives less than the face amount requested due to the discount factor in terminal condition accelerations.

facts.name: Remaining Death Benefit Calculation
facts.sentence: The remaining death benefit payable upon death equals the original benefit minus the accelerated amount minus the discount adjustment.

facts.name: Chronic Condition Acceleration Eligibility
facts.sentence: A chronic condition acceleration is available if the insured satisfies the definition of a Qualifying Chronic Condition.

facts.name: Chronic Condition Annual Acceleration
facts.sentence: Annual accelerations of up to 24% of the then-current death benefit are allowed under the chronic condition provision.

facts.name: Chronic Condition Annual Cap
facts.sentence: The maximum annual acceleration amount under the chronic condition provision is $100,000.

facts.name: Annual Renewal of Chronic Acceleration
facts.sentence: Chronic condition accelerations may be made annually and renewed each year the condition persists.

facts.name: Chronic Benefit Reduction Rule
facts.sentence: Each chronic condition acceleration reduces the remaining death benefit by the accelerated amount plus the applicable discount adjustment.

facts.name: Chronic Benefit Cease Threshold
facts.sentence: Accelerations under the chronic condition provision cease when the remaining death benefit falls below $50,000.

facts.name: Physician Certification Requirement
facts.sentence: Acceleration requires written physician certification of the qualifying condition submitted on Form AP-ABR-CERT.

facts.name: Insurer Medical Verification Right
facts.sentence: The insurer reserves the right to require an independent medical examination at its own expense.

facts.name: Medicaid Eligibility Impact
facts.sentence: Accelerated benefits may affect Medicaid eligibility.

facts.name: Government Benefit Impact Warning
facts.sentence: Accelerated benefits may affect other government benefit programs.

facts.name: Financial Advisor Recommendation
facts.sentence: It is recommended that the owner consult a financial advisor before electing acceleration.

facts.name: No Additional Premium
facts.sentence: This rider is provided at no additional premium.

facts.name: Automatic Rider Inclusion
facts.sentence: This rider is automatically included with this policy.

facts.name: Layer 2 Rider Death Benefit
facts.sentence: The Layer 2 Additional Term Rider provides an additional $300,000 of level term death benefit.

facts.name: Layer 2 Rider Duration
facts.sentence: The Layer 2 Rider is effective for the first 10 policy years.

facts.name: No Additional Premium Rider
facts.sentence: The Layer 2 Rider is provided at no additional premium.

facts.name: Layer 2 Rider Inclusion
facts.sentence: The Layer 2 Rider is automatically included with this policy.

facts.name: Layer 2 Rider Premium Cost
facts.sentence: The rider premium for the Layer 2 Rider is $22.00 per month.

facts.name: Separate Rider Premium Statement
facts.sentence: The rider premium amount of $22.00 per month is separately stated.

facts.name: Rider Cancellation Option
facts.sentence: The Layer 2 Rider may be individually canceled by written request to Atlas Premier Life.

facts.name: Rider Cancellation Independence
facts.sentence: Canceling the Layer 2 Rider does not affect the base policy.

facts.name: Rider Expiration Date
facts.sentence: The Layer 2 Rider expires automatically on June 3, 2034.

facts.name: Rider Expiration Date
facts.sentence: June 3, 2034, corresponds to the 10th policy anniversary.

facts.name: No Conversion Right for Layer 2 Rider
facts.sentence: No conversion right attaches to the Layer 2 Rider independently.

facts.name: No Continuation Right for Layer 2 Rider
facts.sentence: No continuation right attaches to the Layer 2 Rider independently.

facts.name: Rider Participation in Accelerated Benefits
facts.sentence: The Layer 2 Rider participates in the accelerated benefit provisions of Section 6 while in force.

facts.name: Total Monthly Premium
facts.sentence: The total monthly premium for the policy is $61.00.

facts.name: Monthly Premium Due Date
facts.sentence: The total monthly premium of $61.00 is due on the 3rd of each month.

facts.name: Grace Period for Missed Payments
facts.sentence: A grace period of 31 days applies to each missed payment.

facts.name: Policy Lapse Due to Non-Payment
facts.sentence: Non-payment beyond the grace period results in lapse.

facts.name: Policy Lapse Consequences
facts.sentence: Lapse terminates all benefits under the policy.

facts.name: Rider Termination Upon Lapse
facts.sentence: Lapse terminates the Accelerated Benefit Rider.

facts.name: Policy Reinstatement Window
facts.sentence: Reinstatement is available within 3 years of lapse.

facts.name: Reinstatement Evidence Requirement
facts.sentence: Reinstatement requires evidence of insurability.

facts.name: Reinstatement Premium Requirement
facts.sentence: Reinstatement requires payment of all overdue premiums.

facts.name: Reinstatement Interest Requirement
facts.sentence: Reinstatement requires payment of 6% annual interest on overdue premiums.

facts.name: Suicide Clause – Premium Refund
facts.sentence: If the insured dies by suicide within two years of the issue date, liability is limited to a refund of premiums paid.

facts.name: Refundable Premiums Include Riders
facts.sentence: Premiums refunded include both base policy premiums and rider premiums.

facts.name: Accelerated Benefit Exclusion
facts.sentence: The accelerated benefit will not be paid if the qualifying condition is caused by intentional self-inflicted injury.

facts.name: Self-Injury Exclusion
facts.sentence: Intentional self-inflicted injury excludes acceleration of benefits if it occurs within two years of the issue date.

facts.name: No Additional Exclusions
facts.sentence: No other exclusions apply besides those specified in Section 9.

facts.name: Issue Date Reference
facts.sentence: The issue date is referenced in the document.

facts.name: No Additional Exclusions
facts.sentence: No other exclusions apply beyond those specified.

facts.name: Policy Conversion Privilege
facts.sentence: The base policy (Layer 1) may be converted to any permanent plan offered by Atlas Premier.

facts.name: No Evidence Required for Conversion
facts.sentence: Conversion of the base policy requires no evidence of insurability.

facts.name: Conversion Deadline Conditions
facts.sentence: Conversion must occur before the earlier of: the 13th policy anniversary, or the insured's attained age 65.

facts.name: Conversion Amount Unaffected by Accelerations
facts.sentence: Prior accelerated benefit payments do not reduce the conversion amount.

facts.name: Full Conversion Without Reduction
facts.sentence: The full original face amount of $300,000 may be converted even if prior accelerations occurred.

facts.name: Death Claim Documentation Requirement
facts.sentence: For a Death Benefit Claim, Form AP-CLM-DB must be submitted.

facts.name: Death Certificate Requirement
facts.sentence: A certified copy of the death certificate is required for a Death Benefit Claim.

facts.name: Death Benefit Documentation Requirement
facts.sentence: An original policy or a lost-policy affidavit is required for a Death Benefit Claim.

facts.name: Accelerated Benefit Submission Requirement
facts.sentence: For an Accelerated Benefit Claim, Form AP-ABR-REQ must be submitted.

facts.name: Accelerated Benefit Documentation Requirement
facts.sentence: Form AP-ABR-CERT (physician certification) is required for an Accelerated Benefit Claim.

facts.name: Accelerated Benefit Documentation Requirement
facts.sentence: Medical records supporting the diagnosis are required for an Accelerated Benefit Claim.

facts.name: Claim Submission Address
facts.sentence: All claim documents must be sent to Atlas Premier Life Insurance, Inc.

facts.name: Claims Mailing Address
facts.sentence: The mailing address for claims is 3300 Atlas Way, Phoenix, AZ 85016.

facts.name: Claims Division Responsibility
facts.sentence: The claims division responsible is the Living Benefits & Claims Division.

facts.name: Acceleration Request Response Time
facts.sentence: Atlas Premier will respond to acceleration requests within 15 days.

facts.name: Death Claim Payment Timeline
facts.sentence: Valid death claims will be paid within 30 days of approval.

facts.name: Policy Incontestability Clause
facts.sentence: After two years from the issue date, the policy becomes incontestable.

facts.name: Post-Issue Contestability Exception
facts.sentence: Post-issue contestability exceptions are limited to non-payment of premium only.

facts.name: Misstatement of Age/Sex Adjustment
facts.sentence: If there was a misstatement of age or sex, benefits will be adjusted to reflect the amount purchasable at the correct age and sex.

facts.name: Entire Contract Clause
facts.sentence: This policy, along with all attached riders and the application, constitutes the entire contract.

facts.name: Governing Law Clause
facts.sentence: This policy is governed by the laws of [unspecified jurisdiction].

facts.name: Correct Age and Sex Required
facts.sentence: The correct age and sex are required.

facts.name: Entire Agreement Clause
facts.sentence: This policy constitutes the entire agreement.

facts.name: Entire Agreement Scope
facts.sentence: All attached riders constitute the entire agreement.

facts.name: Application as Entire Agreement
facts.sentence: The application constitutes the entire agreement.

facts.name: Governing Law Jurisdiction
facts.sentence: This policy is governed by the laws of the State of Arizona.

facts.name: Chief Underwriting Officer Signature
facts.sentence: The authorized signature is provided by the Chief Underwriting Officer.

facts.name: Policy Issuer Identification
facts.sentence: The company issuing the policy is Atlas Premier Life Insurance, Inc.

facts.name: Policy Issue Date
facts.sentence: The date issued for the policy is June 3, 2024.

facts.name: Policy Number Identification
facts.sentence: The policy number is CH-2024-IT-02244.

facts.name: Issue Date: July 22, 2024
facts.sentence: The issue date of the policy is July 22, 2024.

facts.name: ILIT Policy Structure
facts.sentence: The policy type is 30-Year Level Term — Irrevocable Life Insurance Trust (ILIT) Structure.

facts.name: Policy Ownership Designation
facts.sentence: The policy owner is The Harrington 2024 Irrevocable Life Insurance Trust.

facts.name: Trust Establishment Date
facts.sentence: The Harrington 2024 Irrevocable Life Insurance Trust was established on July 15, 2024.

facts.name: Trustee Designation
facts.sentence: Jonathan R. Caldwell is the trustee of The Harrington 2024 Irrevocable Life Insurance Trust.

facts.name: Trustee Address Details
facts.sentence: The trustee address is 840 Elm Street, Greenwich, CT 06830.

facts.name: Insured Person Identified
facts.sentence: The insured person is Robert Harrington, III.

facts.name: Date of Birth: Jan 6, 1961
facts.sentence: Robert Harrington, III’s date of birth is January 6, 1961.

facts.name: Age at Policy Issuance
facts.sentence: Robert Harrington, III was 63 years old at the time of policy issuance.

facts.name: Tobacco Risk Classification
facts.sentence: Robert Harrington, III is classified under Risk Class: Standard Tobacco.

facts.name: Death Benefit Amount
facts.sentence: The death benefit amount is $5,000,000.

facts.name: Level Death Benefit
facts.sentence: The death benefit is level throughout the term of the policy.

facts.name: 30-Year Policy Term
facts.sentence: The policy term is 30 years.

facts.name: Policy Expiration Date
facts.sentence: The policy expires on July 22, 2054.

facts.name: Annual Premium Amount
facts.sentence: The annual premium is $98,700.00.

facts.name: Annual Premium Due Date
facts.sentence: Premium payments are due annually on July 22 of each policy year.

facts.name: Crummey Contributions Payments
facts.sentence: Payments are made through trust Crummey contributions.

facts.name: Sole Beneficiary Designation
facts.sentence: The sole beneficiary of the policy is The Harrington 2024 Irrevocable Life Insurance Trust.

facts.name: Beneficiary Distribution
facts.sentence: The beneficiary receives 100% of the policy proceeds.

facts.name: Trust-Based Proceeds Distribution
facts.sentence: Policy proceeds are distributed according to the terms of the trust instrument.

facts.name: Distribution Based on Trust Instrument
facts.sentence: Beneficiaries of the trust receive distributions based on the trust instrument.

facts.name: Trust-Owned Policy Tax Exclusion
facts.sentence: Because the trust is both the policy owner and the beneficiary, the proceeds pass outside the insured's taxable estate.

facts.name: Estate Tax Exclusion via ILIT
facts.sentence: The transfer of proceeds outside the insured's taxable estate complies with IRS rules.

facts.name: Full Trust Ownership
facts.sentence: The trust has a 100% ownership interest in the policy.

facts.name: Trust Distribution Mechanism
facts.sentence: Proceeds from the policy are distributed to trust beneficiaries according to the trust instrument.

facts.name: Estate Exclusion via Trust Ownership
facts.sentence: Because the trust is both the owner and beneficiary of the policy, proceeds pass outside the insured's taxable estate.

facts.name: IRS Rules & Estate Exclusion
facts.sentence: IRS rules govern whether proceeds pass outside the insured's taxable estate.

facts.name: Trust Instrument Determines Estate Exclusion
facts.sentence: The terms of the trust instrument also determine whether proceeds pass outside the insured's taxable estate.

facts.name: Tax Treatment Disclaimer
facts.sentence: Cornerstone Heritage does not represent or guarantee the tax treatment of the trust or policy.

facts.name: Death Benefit Definition
facts.sentence: The 'Death Benefit' refers to the $5,000,000 amount payable to the trust beneficiary upon the insured's death.

facts.name: Death Benefit Payout Condition
facts.sentence: The Death Benefit is payable when the policy is in force at the time of the insured’s death.

facts.name: Death Benefit Time Limit
facts.sentence: The Death Benefit is payable only if the insured dies before July 22, 2054.

facts.name: Proof of Death Requirement
facts.sentence: Satisfactory proof of death must be received by the insurer to trigger payment of the Death Benefit.

facts.name: Trustee Payment Authority
facts.sentence: The trustee may provide instructions regarding the payment of the Death Benefit.

facts.name: Successor Trustee Authority
facts.sentence: A successor trustee may provide instructions regarding the payment of the Death Benefit.

facts.name: Trustee Settlement Authority
facts.sentence: Instructions from the trustee or successor trustee include elections related to settlement options.

facts.name: Insurer Not Responsible for Distribution Compliance
facts.sentence: The insurer is not responsible for verifying that the trustee distributes proceeds in compliance with the trust instrument.

facts.name: Insurer's Limited Obligation
facts.sentence: The insurer’s sole obligation is to pay the named beneficiary of record.

facts.name: Death Benefit Payout Timeline
facts.sentence: Payment of the Death Benefit is made within 30 days after claim approval.

facts.name: Trustee Definition
facts.sentence: The term 'Trustee' refers to the person named as trustee under the Harrington 2024 ILIT.

facts.name: Successor Trustee Inclusion
facts.sentence: Any duly appointed successor to the trustee is considered part of the definition of 'Trustee'.

facts.sentence: The term 'Successor Trustee' includes any individual or institution assuming trusteeship after the current trustee resigns.

facts.name: Crummey Contribution Definition
facts.sentence: A Crummey Contribution is defined as an annual gift made by the grantor to the trust.

facts.name: Crummey Contribution Purpose
facts.sentence: The purpose of a Crummey Contribution is to fund premium payments on the policy.

facts.name: Crummey Contribution Compliance
facts.sentence: A Crummey Contribution complies with IRC § 2503(c) withdrawal rights.

facts.name: Grace Period Definition
facts.sentence: The Grace Period is a 60-day window following a missed annual premium due date.

facts.name: Grace Period Coverage Continuity
facts.sentence: Coverage remains in force during the Grace Period.

facts.name: Grace Period Alignment

facts.name: Insurer’s Payment Obligation
facts.sentence: The only obligation of the insurer is to pay the named beneficiary of record.

facts.name: Claim Settlement Timeline
facts.sentence: Payment is made within 30 days of claim approval.

facts.name: Trustee Authority Protocol
facts.sentence: The insurer deals exclusively with the trustee of record as the policy owner.

facts.name: Trustee Appointment Verification
facts.sentence: Written evidence of trustee appointment must be received before dealing with the trustee of record.

facts.name: Successor Trustee Documentation Requirement
facts.sentence: Upon a change of trustee, the successor trustee must provide a certified copy of the trust instrument confirming the succession mechanism.

facts.name: Successor Trustee Acceptance Requirement
facts.sentence: Upon a change of trustee, the successor trustee must provide a written letter of acceptance.

facts.name: Trustee Authority Limitation
facts.sentence: The insurer will not honor policy transactions from any party other than the trustee of record.

facts.name: Policy Transactions Defined
facts.sentence: Policy transactions include beneficiary changes, conversions, and assignments.

facts.name: Trustee Liability Protection
facts.sentence: The insurer assumes no liability for acts taken in good faith in reliance on trustee instructions.

facts.name: Annual Premium Due Date
facts.sentence: The annual premium is due on July 22 of each policy year.

facts.name: Extended Grace Period Duration
facts.sentence: An extended grace period of 60 days applies to the policy.

facts.name: Grace Period Justification
facts.sentence: The extended grace period reflects the annual payment mode and ILIT funding timelines.

facts.name: Grace Period Coverage Continuity
facts.sentence: Coverage remains fully in force during the grace period.

facts.name: Premium Non-Payment Consequence
facts.sentence: If the premium is not received within the grace period, the policy lapses.

facts.name: No Cash Value on Lapse
facts.sentence: When the policy lapses, there is no cash value.

facts.name: No Surrender Value on Lapse
facts.sentence: When the policy lapses, there is no surrender value.

facts.name: Policy Reinstatement Window
facts.sentence: Reinstatement is available within 5 years of lapse.

facts.name: Reinstatement Insurability Requirement
facts.sentence: Evidence of insurability satisfactory to the insurer is required for reinstatement.

facts.name: Reinstatement Interest Requirement
facts.sentence: Overdue premiums must be paid with 6% interest for reinstatement.

facts.name: Trustee Authorization Required
facts.sentence: A written authorization from the trustee is required for reinstatement.

facts.name: Suicide Clause Trigger
facts.sentence: The suicide clause applies if the insured dies by suicide within two years of the issue date.

facts.name: Suicide Clause Applicability
facts.sentence: The suicide clause applies regardless of whether the death occurs while sane or insane.

facts.name: Suicide Clause Liability Limit
facts.sentence: Under the suicide clause, liability is limited to a refund of premiums paid to the trust.

facts.name: No Additional Exclusions
facts.sentence: No other exclusions apply to this policy.

facts.name: Trust Ownership Structure
facts.sentence: This policy is owned by an irrevocable trust.

facts.name: Grantor Is Insured
facts.sentence: The grantor of the trust is also the insured.

facts.name: Grantor Ownership Restrictions
facts.sentence: The grantor (insured) has no ownership rights in this policy.

facts.name: Grantor Cannot Surrender Policy
facts.sentence: The grantor may not surrender this policy.

facts.name: Grantor Cannot Cancel Policy
facts.sentence: The grantor may not cancel this policy.

facts.name: Grantor Cannot Change Beneficiary
facts.sentence: The grantor may not change the beneficiary designation on this policy.

facts.name: Grantor borrowing prohibition
facts.sentence: The grantor may not borrow against this policy.

facts.name: Grantor Cannot Assign Policy
facts.sentence: The grantor may not assign this policy.

facts.name: Grantor Ownership Restrictions
facts.sentence: The grantor may not exercise any other ownership rights over this policy.

facts.name: No Additional Exclusions
facts.sentence: No other exclusions apply to this policy.

facts.name: Trustee Assignment Permission
facts.sentence: The trustee may assign this policy to a successor trustee of the same trust.

facts.name: Court-directed policy assignment
facts.sentence: The trustee may assign this policy as directed by a court of competent jurisdiction.

facts.name: Collateral Assignment Restriction
facts.sentence: A collateral assignment of this policy is not permitted without a court order.

facts.name: Trustee Conversion Right
facts.sentence: The trustee may convert this policy to a permanent life insurance plan offered by Cornerstone Heritage.

facts.name: No Medical Exam for Conversion
facts.sentence: Conversion to a permanent life insurance plan requires no evidence of insurability.

facts.name: Age Limit for Policy Conversion
facts.sentence: The insured’s attained age must not exceed 75 at the time of conversion request.

facts.name: Conversion Deadline Constraint
facts.sentence: Conversion must be requested before the 25th anniversary of the policy.

facts.name: Trust Ownership After Conversion
facts.sentence: The converted policy will be owned by the trust.

facts.name: Trust Existence Verification
facts.sentence: The trustee must provide evidence of continued trust existence prior to conversion.

facts.name: Trustee Authority Requirement

facts.sentence: Claims must be submitted to the Trust & Estate Claims Division.

facts.name: Claim Payment Timeline
facts.sentence: Valid claims will be paid within 30 days of receiving all required documentation.

facts.name: Address of One Heritage Square
facts.sentence: One Heritage Square is located in Hartford, CT 06103.

facts.sentence: Cornerstone Heritage Life Insurance Company issued the policy.

facts.sentence: The policy was issued on July 22, 2024.

facts.name: Policy Authorization Authority
facts.sentence: The senior vice president of advanced markets authorized the signature on the policy.

facts.name: Claim Payment Timeline
facts.sentence: Section 11.3 states that valid claims will be paid within 30 days of receiving all required documentation.

facts.name: Incontestability Clause
facts.sentence: Section 12.1 establishes an incontestability provision effective two years after the issue date.

facts.name: Post-Contestability Protection
facts.sentence: After two years from the issue date, the insurer may not contest the policy based on statements made in the application.

facts.name: Exception to Incontestability Clause
facts.sentence: An exception to the incontestability clause allows contestation due to non-payment of premium.

facts.name: Misstatement of Age or Sex Adjustment
facts.sentence: Section 12.2 addresses misstatement of age or sex.

facts.name: Misstatement of Age/Sex Adjustment
facts.sentence: If there is a misstatement of age or sex, benefits will be adjusted to reflect the amount that would have been purchased at the correct age and sex.

facts.name: Entire Contract Clause
facts.sentence: Section 12.3 specifies that the policy and the application together constitute the entire contract.

facts.name: Trust Instrument Exclusion
facts.sentence: The trust instrument is not considered part of the contractual agreement.

facts.name: Governing Law Jurisdiction
facts.sentence: Section 12.4 indicates that the governing law for this policy is the State of Connecticut.

facts.sentence: No reinstatement right exists under this policy.

facts.name: No Reinstatement Right
facts.sentence: Reinstatement requires the insured to re-apply for a new policy.

facts.name: Suicide Clause Limitation
facts.sentence: If the insured dies by suicide within two years of the issue date, the insurer’s liability is limited to a refund of premiums paid.

facts.name: Suicide Mental State Definition
facts.sentence: Suicide includes both sane and insane states of mind.

facts.name: Suicide After Two Years
facts.sentence: After two years from the issue date, the full death benefit is payable upon suicide-related death.

facts.name: Pre-Existing Condition Exclusion
facts.sentence: If the insured dies within the first two policy years and the cause of death is directly related to a pre-existing condition, no benefit is payable beyond the graded benefit.

facts.name: Pre-Existing Condition Disclosure Requirement
facts.sentence: A pre-existing condition must have been undisclosed on the application for the exclusion to apply.

facts.name: Pre-Existing Condition Exclusion
facts.sentence: Section 9.2 excludes benefits when death is caused by an undisclosed pre-existing condition during the first two policy years.

facts.name: Accidental Death Benefit
facts.sentence: Notwithstanding Sections 6 and 9.2, the full face amount of $150,000 is payable in cases of accidental death.

facts.name: Nondisclosure Limitation
facts.sentence: A benefit is not payable beyond the graded benefit in Section 6 if information was not disclosed on the application.

facts.name: Accidental Death Exception
facts.sentence: Section 9.3 provides an Accidental Death Exception to Sections 6 and 9.2.

facts.name: Accidental Death Benefit
facts.sentence: Under Section 9.3, the full face amount of $150,000 is payable at any time if the insured's death results solely and directly from an accidental bodily injury.

facts.name: Accidental Death Time Limit
facts.sentence: For the accidental death benefit under Section 9.3, the accidental bodily injury must occur within 90 days of the accident.

facts.name: Accidental Injury Independence
facts.sentence: For the accidental death benefit under Section 9.3, the accidental bodily injury must be independent of illness or disease.

facts.name: Accidental Death: Non-Self-Injury Rule
facts.sentence: For the accidental death benefit under Section 9.3, the accidental bodily injury must not be self-inflicted.

facts.name: Accidental Death Exclusion: Impairment
facts.sentence: For the accidental death benefit under Section 9.3, the accidental bodily injury must not result from alcohol or drug impairment.

facts.name: Voluntary Intoxication Exclusion
facts.sentence: No benefit, including accidental benefit, is payable under Section 9.4 if death results directly from voluntary intoxication by alcohol.

facts.name: Drug Intoxication Exclusion
facts.sentence: No benefit, including accidental benefit, is payable under Section 9.4 if death results directly from voluntary intoxication by non-prescribed drugs.

facts.name: Drug and Alcohol Exclusion
facts.sentence: No benefit, including accidental benefit, is payable under Section 9.4 if death results directly from voluntary intoxication by illegal substances.

facts.name: No Conversion Privilege
facts.sentence: This simplified issue policy does not include a conversion privilege.

facts.name: No Conversion Privilege
facts.sentence: No right to convert to a permanent policy exists under this contract.

facts.name: Post-expiry Reapplication Option
facts.sentence: Upon expiry, the insured may apply for a new policy.

facts.name: New Application Underwriting Requirement
facts.sentence: Any new policy application upon expiry is subject to underwriting at the time of re-application.

facts.name: Claim Submission Requirement
facts.sentence: To file a claim, Form SC-CLM-SI must be completed.

facts.name: Claim Form Availability
facts.sentence: Form SC-CLM-SI is available at www.swiftcoverlife.com/claims.

facts.name: Claim Documentation Requirement
facts.sentence: To file a claim, a certified copy of the death certificate must be submitted.

facts.name: Physician Statement Requirement
facts.sentence: If death occurs within the first two policy years, an attending physician's statement must be provided.

facts.name: Accidental Death Documentation Requirement
facts.sentence: If the death is due to accidental causes, a police or accident report must be submitted.

facts.name: Claim Submission Location
facts.sentence: Claims must be submitted to SwiftCover Life Insurance Group.

facts.name: Claim Submission Address
facts.sentence: Claims must be sent to the Claims Department of SwiftCover Life Insurance Group.

facts.name: Claims Mailing Address
facts.sentence: The mailing address for claims submission is P.O. Box 4422, Denver, CO 80201.

facts.name: Claims Submission Method
facts.sentence: Alternatively, claims can be emailed to claims@swiftcoverlife.com.

facts.name: Claim Payment Timeline
facts.sentence: Valid claims are paid within 30 days of approval.

facts.name: Policy Incontestability Clause
facts.sentence: After two years from the issue date, the policy becomes incontestable.

facts.name: Policy Incontestability Clause
facts.sentence: This policy becomes incontestable two years after its issue date.

facts.name: Incontestability Clause
facts.sentence: After two years from the issue date, the insurer will not contest the policy for misrepresentation.

facts.name: Exception to Incontestability
facts.sentence: The only exception to the incontestability provision is non-payment of premium.

facts.name: Age Misstatement Adjustment
facts.sentence: If age is misstated on the policy, benefits will be adjusted accordingly.

facts.name: Misstatement of Sex Adjustment
facts.sentence: If sex is misstated on the policy, benefits will be adjusted accordingly.

facts.name: Entire Contract Clause
facts.sentence: The policy and the application together constitute the entire contract between the parties.

facts.name: Governing Law Jurisdiction
facts.sentence: This policy is governed by the laws of the State of Colorado.

facts.name: Authorized Signatory Role
facts.sentence: The authorized signature on this policy was provided by the Chief Product Officer of SwiftCover Life Insurance Group.

facts.name: Issuing Entity Name
facts.sentence: The name of the issuing entity is SwiftCover Life Insurance Group.

facts.name: Policy Issue Date
facts.sentence: The policy was issued on August 14, 2024.

facts.name: Policy Issue Date
facts.sentence: The issue date of the policy is September 2, 2024.

facts.name: Charitable Legacy Policy Type
facts.sentence: The policy type is 20-Year Level Term — Charitable Legacy Plan.

facts.name: Split-Beneficiary Structure
facts.sentence: The policy has a Split-Beneficiary Structure.

facts.name: Policy Owner Identification
facts.sentence: The policy owner is Dr. Margaret Yvonne Chu.

facts.name: Insured Person Identified
facts.sentence: The insured person is Dr. Margaret Yvonne Chu.

facts.name: Insured Date of Birth
facts.sentence: The date of birth of the insured person is June 17, 1970.

facts.name: Insured Age at Issue
facts.sentence: The age of the insured person at issue is 54 years.

facts.name: Preferred Non-Tobacco Risk Class
facts.sentence: The risk class of the insured person is Preferred Non-Tobacco.

facts.name: Total Death Benefit Amount
facts.sentence: The total death benefit of the policy is $1,200,000.

facts.name: Level Death Benefit
facts.sentence: The total death benefit is level throughout the term.

facts.name: Personal Tranche Amount
facts.sentence: The personal tranche of the death benefit is $800,000.

facts.name: Personal Tranche Allocation
facts.sentence: The personal tranche represents 66.67% of the total death benefit.

facts.name: Charitable Tranche Amount
facts.sentence: The charitable tranche of the death benefit is $400,000.

facts.name: Charitable Tranche Allocation
facts.sentence: The charitable tranche represents 33.33% of the total death benefit.

facts.name: Policy Duration
facts.sentence: The policy term is 20 years.

facts.name: Policy Expiration Date
facts.sentence: The policy expires on September 2, 2044.

facts.name: Monthly Premium Amount
facts.sentence: The monthly premium amount is $535.00.

facts.name: Monthly Automatic Deduction
facts.sentence: The payment mode is monthly automatic deduction.

facts.name: Primary Beneficiary – Personal Tranche
facts.sentence: The primary beneficiary of the personal tranche is Henry Joon Chu.

facts.name: Spousal Relationship Confirmation
facts.sentence: Henry Joon Chu is the spouse of Dr. Margaret Yvonne Chu.

facts.name: Primary Beneficiary Allocation
facts.sentence: The primary beneficiary of the personal tranche receives 100% of that tranche.

facts.name: Contingent Beneficiary Designation
facts.sentence: The contingent beneficiary of the personal tranche is the Chu Family Living Trust.

facts.name: Chu Family Trust Establishment Date
facts.sentence: The Chu Family Living Trust was established on June 1, 2020.

facts.name: Contingent Beneficiary Allocation
facts.sentence: The contingent beneficiary of the personal tranche receives 100% of that tranche.

facts.name: Primary Charity Beneficiary
facts.sentence: The primary beneficiary of the charitable tranche is Northgate Community Foundation.

facts.name: EIN for Charity Designation
facts.sentence: Northgate Community Foundation has an Employer Identification Number (EIN) of 82-4401200.

facts.name: Northgate Address Confirmation
facts.sentence: The mailing address of Northgate Community Foundation is 500 Civic Center Drive.

facts.name: Primary Charitable Recipient
facts.sentence: The Charitable Tranche Beneficiary is primarily the Northgate Community Foundation.

facts.name: Northgate EIN Verification
facts.sentence: The EIN of the Northgate Community Foundation is 82-4401200.

facts.name: Northgate Address
facts.sentence: The address of the Northgate Community Foundation is 500 Civic Center Drive, Portland, OR 97201.

facts.name: Contingent Beneficiary Designation
facts.sentence: The contingent Charitable Tranche Beneficiary is the American Red Cross — National Chapter.

facts.name: Beneficiary Change Rights
facts.sentence: The Charitable Tranche Beneficiary may be changed to any IRC § 501(c)(3) organization by written request to Philanthropy Life.

facts.name: Spousal Consent Requirement
facts.sentence: The Personal Tranche Beneficiary is subject to standard spousal consent requirements.

facts.name: Personal Tranche Definition
facts.sentence: A 'Personal Tranche' refers to the $800,000 death benefit payable to the personal beneficiary as designated above.

facts.name: Charitable Tranche Definition
facts.sentence: A 'Charitable Tranche' refers to the $400,000 death benefit payable to the qualifying charitable organization designated above.

facts.name: Qualifying Charity Definition
facts.sentence: 'Qualifying Charity' means an organization exempt from federal income tax under IRC § 501(c)(3) at the time a claim is filed.

facts.name: Charitable Substitution Right
facts.sentence: 'Charitable Substitution Right' means the owner's right to change the charitable tranche beneficiary to any Qualifying Charity.

facts.name: Grace Period Definition
facts.sentence: 'Grace Period' means the 31-day period following each missed monthly due date.

facts.name: Death Benefit Payout Trigger
facts.sentence: Upon the insured's death while this policy is in force before September 2, 2044, the company will pay the Personal Tranche to the designated personal beneficiary.

facts.name: Charitable Tranche Payment Obligation
facts.sentence: Upon the insured's death while this policy is in force before September 2, 2044, the company will pay the Charitable Tranche to the designated charitable beneficiary.

facts.name: Simultaneous Tranched Payout
facts.sentence: Both tranches are paid simultaneously within 30 days of claim approval.

facts.name: Contingent Beneficiary Payment Rule
facts.sentence: If the designated Qualifying Charity has lost its IRC § 501(c)(3) status at the time of claim, the Charitable Tranche will be paid to the contingent charitable beneficiary.

facts.name: Contingent Beneficiary Failure
facts.sentence: If the contingent beneficiary also does not qualify, the Charitable Tranche will be held.

facts.name: Charitable Tranche Payment Condition
facts.sentence: The Charitable Tranche will be paid to the contingent charitable beneficiary if the entity holds 501(c)(3) status at the time of claim.

facts.name: Contingent Beneficiary Disqualification Protocol
facts.sentence: If the contingent charitable beneficiary does not qualify for 501(c)(3) status, the Charitable Tranche will be held pending the owner's or estate's direction for up to 180 days.

facts.name: Charitable Tranche Default Distribution
facts.sentence: After 180 days, if no direction is received from the owner or estate, the Charitable Tranche will be distributed to the personal tranche contingent beneficiary.

facts.name: Tax Deductibility Disclaimer
facts.sentence: Philanthropy Life makes no representations regarding the tax deductibility of premiums for any tax purpose.

facts.name: Tax Treatment Disclaimer
facts.sentence: Philanthropy Life makes no representations regarding the charitable nature of the benefit for any tax purpose.

facts.name: Owner Beneficiary Change Right
facts.sentence: The owner may change the charitable tranche beneficiary to any Qualifying Charity at any time without requiring consent from the current charitable beneficiary.

facts.name: Charitable Substitution Requirement
facts.sentence: A charitable substitution request must include a written request signed by the owner.

facts.name: Charitable Substitution EIN Requirement
facts.sentence: A charitable substitution request must include the Employer Identification Number (EIN) of the proposed charitable beneficiary.

facts.name: Charity Status Verification Requirement
facts.sentence: A charitable substitution request must include evidence of the proposed charitable beneficiary’s IRC § 501(c)(3) status.

facts.name: Beneficiary Change Effective Date
facts.sentence: Changes to the charitable tranche beneficiary become effective upon receipt at Philanthropy Life’s home office.

facts.name: Non-Retroactive Beneficiary Changes
facts.sentence: Changes to the charitable tranche beneficiary are not retroactive.

facts.name: Beneficiary Authority Limitation
facts.sentence: The personal tranche beneficiary has no right to direct, restrict, or otherwise affect the charitable tranche designation.

facts.name: Altruism Recognition
facts.sentence: Philanthropy Life recognizes the altruistic nature of the Charitable Legacy Plan structure.

facts.name: 5% Charitable Designation Credit
facts.sentence: The monthly premium includes a 5% Charitable Designation Credit applied to the total premium.

facts.name: Base Premium Without Credit
facts.sentence: The base premium without the Charitable Designation Credit would be $562.50 per month.

facts.name: Credit Continuity Condition
facts.sentence: The Charitable Designation Credit is maintained for as long as the policy remains in force with a Qualifying Charity as the charitable tranche beneficiary.

facts.name: Premium Recalibration on Non-Charity Change
facts.sentence: If the owner removes the charitable tranche beneficiary and designates a non-charitable beneficiary, the premium will be recalculated at the standard rate of $562.50 per month.

facts.name: Premium Recalculation Timing
facts.sentence: The recalculated premium becomes effective the following policy anniversary.

facts.name: Premium Due Date
facts.sentence: Monthly premiums are due on the 2nd of each month.

facts.name: Grace Period Duration
facts.sentence: A 31-day grace period follows each missed due date.

facts.name: Policy Lapse Due to Non-Payment
facts.sentence: Non-payment after the grace period causes lapse of the entire policy.

facts.name: Policy Lapse Affects Both Tranches
facts.sentence: The entire policy includes both tranches when it lapses.

facts.name: Policy Reinstatement Window
facts.sentence: Reinstatement is available within 3 years of lapse.

facts.name: Reinstatement Requirement
facts.sentence: Evidence of insurability is required for reinstatement.

facts.name: Reinstatement Requires Overdue Payment
facts.sentence: Overdue premiums must be paid for reinstatement.

facts.name: Reinstatement Interest Rate
facts.sentence: Six percent annual interest applies to overdue premiums during reinstatement.

facts.name: Suicide Liability Limit
facts.sentence: If the insured dies by suicide within two years of the issue date, liability is limited.

facts.name: Suicide Exclusion Limit
facts.sentence: Liability for suicide within two years is limited to a refund of premiums paid.

facts.name: Suicide Clause Refund Allocation
facts.sentence: Premiums refunded under the suicide clause are allocated proportionally between the personal and charitable tranches.

facts.name: Only Suicide Clause Excluded
facts.sentence: No other exclusions apply besides the suicide clause.

facts.name: Conversion Privilege Right
facts.sentence: The owner may convert all or a portion of this policy to a permanent life insurance plan offered by Philanthropy Life.

facts.name: No Evidence of Insurability Required
facts.sentence: Conversion does not require evidence of insurability.

facts.name: Conversion Deadline Conditions
facts.sentence: Conversion must occur before the earlier of the 18th policy anniversary or the insured's attained age 70.

facts.name: Split-Beneficiary Maintenance
facts.sentence: Upon conversion, the split-beneficiary structure may be maintained.

facts.name: Conversion Beneficiary Restructuring
facts.sentence: Upon conversion, the split-beneficiary structure may be restructured.

facts.name: Conversion Beneficiary Option
facts.sentence: The owner may elect to maintain or restructure the split-beneficiary structure upon conversion.

facts.name: Charitable Credit on Conversion
facts.sentence: The Charitable Designation Credit applies to the converted policy's premium.

facts.name: Charitable Tranche Condition
facts.sentence: The Charitable Designation Credit applies only if the charitable tranche designation is maintained.

facts.name: Personal Claim Documentation
facts.sentence: Personal beneficiary claim documents include Form PL-CLM-PERS.

facts.name: Death Certificate Requirement
facts.sentence: Personal beneficiary claim documents include a certified copy of the death certificate.

facts.name: Charitable Claim Documentation
facts.sentence: Charitable beneficiary claim documents include Form PL-CLM-CHAR.

facts.name: Monthly Premium Rate
facts.sentence: The standard rate for calculation is $562.50 per month.

facts.name: Premium Adjustment Effective Next Anniversary
facts.sentence: The calculated amount becomes effective the following policy anniversary.

facts.name: Personal Claim Form Identification
facts.sentence: Form PL-CLM-PERS is the personal claim form.

facts.name: Death Certificate Requirement
facts.sentence: A certified copy of the death certificate is required for a personal claim.

facts.name: Charitable Claim Form Designation
facts.sentence: Form PL-CLM-CHAR is the charitable claim form.

facts.name: Charitable Claim Requirement
facts.sentence: Evidence of current § 501(c)(3) status is required for a charitable beneficiary claim.

facts.name: Simultaneous Claim Filing
facts.sentence: Both personal and charitable claims may be filed simultaneously.

facts.name: Claim Submission Address
facts.sentence: Claims should be sent to Philanthropy Life Assurance Co. – Claims Division.

facts.name: Claims Mailing Address
facts.sentence: The mailing address for claims is 700 Legacy Avenue, Portland, OR 97204.

facts.name: Claim Payment Timeline
facts.sentence: Valid claims will be paid within 30 days of complete filing.

facts.name: Incontestability Clause
facts.sentence: This policy cannot be contested after two years from the issue date.

facts.name: Exception to Incontestability
facts.sentence: The exception to incontestability is non-payment of premium.

facts.name: Misstatement of Age or Sex Adjustment
facts.sentence: If age or sex was misstated on the policy, benefits will be adjusted proportionally across both tranches.

facts.name: Entire Contract Clause
facts.sentence: This policy and the application together constitute the entire contract.

facts.name: Governing Law Clause
facts.sentence: This policy is governed by the laws of the State of Oregon.

facts.name: Authorized Signatory Role
facts.sentence: The authorized signature on the document is that of the President, Mission Products Division.

facts.name: Issuing Company Identification
facts.sentence: Philanthropy Life Assurance Co. is the issuing company.

facts.name: Document Issue Date
facts.sentence: The date issued for this document is September 2, 2024.
